programmes.d: The harrowing story of two narcotics agents (Jason Patric, Jennifer Jason Leigh) who become horribly addicted to the very substance they are supposed to keep off the streets. Supporting cast includes Sam Elliott.

A woman (Keira Knightley) stuck in permanent adolescence lies to her fiancé about going on a retreat and spends the time hanging out with teenagers (Chloe Grace Moretz) instead. A comedy about acting your age and other adult decisions.

While a maverick creator of America's favorite game shows gains notoriety for his smash TV hits, he navigates into a shadowy world of danger as a covert government operative. George Clooney directs this incredible stranger-than-fiction story.
A misfit guy (Sam Rockwell) is brought on to coach the local girls' high school basketball team, but he never imagined how this experience would alter his life and theirs.
A comedy of Biblical proportions from the creators of NAPOLEON DYNAMITE. A self-proclaimed Biblical archaeologist fuels a comic conspiracy when he tries to cover up his failure.
A jewel thief's nephew is sent along on a heist to ensure a longtime partner in crime stays honest about the division of the loot.
Sam Bell (Sam Rockwell) is nearing the completion of his 3-year-long contract with Lunar Industries, mining Earth's primary source of energy on the dark side of the moon.
